anya: Quick heads-up — tabletop run for the QBR next Tue 11am PT. Need demo owners, a recording fallback, and explicit exec bullets for renewal risks. Slides here: https://redwood.box/qbr_deck_v2. Can owners ack?
maria: I can own the onboarding slide + run the live sandbox demo. Marking as owner. @liam can you standby as recording fallback?
liam: @maria yep I can do the recording fallback. What's the expected demo duration? Also suggest we add a one-slide summary for renewal risks (slides 6-8) with 3 exec bullets.
devon: I'll draft the exec bullets and run the tabletop script. Mini checklist for run: 1) slide check 2) recording config 3) fallback play. Quick runbook command: ```./scripts/qbr_runbook.sh --check-slides```
anya: Thanks — action items: maria -> onboarding demo + slides, liam -> recording fallback & test VM, devon -> exec bullets + canary messaging, anya -> confirm invite list and sales ops ask. Please react with :white_check_mark: when done.
maria: ✅ Started slide edits, will finish EOD Fri and upload final deck version to the same folder.
liam: I'll spin up a test VM and validate recording Thu morning. If anyone wants the recording snippet embedded in notes let me know.
devon: Added 3 exec-facing bullets and a suggested SLO/renewal note. Flagging that we should include a customer health snapshot (last 90d) slide. @anya can you pull the health numbers or ping analytics?
anya: Pinging analytics and sales-ops now. Also created a short checklist in deck notes and added owners to speaker notes. calendar-bot: Event created — QBR Tabletop (Tue 11:00 PT) attendees: anya, maria, liam, devon, sales-ops.
anya: Great progress — if no blockers, I'll run a quick dry run Mon 4pm PT to validate transitions and fallback flow.
